textNodes.text: Studio Chroma prints art books and runs a website, and the two never matched. Every reprint started with a week of colour arguments.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: They asked for one palette that behaves the same on screen and on paper, documented so their freelancers could use it without calling them.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Printed a test sheet of their current colours on three paper stocks
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Rebuilt the palette in a perceptual colour space so steps look even
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Matched every screen colour to a print recipe and checked it on press
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Built a small web tool that shows each colour on screen next to its print values
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Wrote a short guide with the do's and don'ts for designers and printers
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
